diagrams.title: Order platform overview
diagrams.source:
flowchart LR
    C[Checkout] --> P{Payment}

    P -->|failed| R[Manual review]
    F -->|completed order| A[Analytics]
    F -->|shipment| N[Notifications]

diagrams.title: Payment and fulfillment
diagrams.source:
flowchart LR
    C[Checkout] --> P{Authorize payment}
    P -->|approved| F[Fulfillment]
    P -->|retryable| T[Retry]
    T --> P
    P -->|review| R[Manual review]
    R -->|approved| F
    R -->|rejected| X[Cancel order]

diagrams.title: Event consumers
diagrams.source:
flowchart LR
    O[Completed order] --> A[Analytics]
    S[Shipment event] --> N[Notifications]
    N --> U[Customer]

diagrams.title: Proposal cycle
diagrams.source:
flowchart LR
    D[Draft] --> R[Review] --> F[Findings] --> V[Revise]
    V --> RR[Re-review] --> A{Approve?}
    A -->|yes| P[Publish]
    A -->|changes| V
    A -->|scope changed| D

diagrams.title: 業務フロー全体

    V -->|未達| E

diagrams.title: 企画と承認
diagrams.source:
flowchart LR
    R[依頼・情報確認] --> H[仮説と計画]
    H --> PR[計画レビュー]
    PR --> A{承認}
    A -->|修正| H
    A -->|承認| N[実行へ]

diagrams.title: 実行と検証
diagrams.source:
flowchart LR
    S[環境準備] --> E[作業実行] --> M[中間確認]
    M -->|追加対応| E
    M --> Q[品質確認]
    Q -->|差し戻し| E
    Q -->|合格| R[報告・共有] --> D[完了通知]

diagrams.title: Checkout sequence
diagrams.source:
sequenceDiagram
    participant C as Customer
    participant S as Storefront
    participant O as Order API
    participant I as Inventory
    participant P as Payment
    participant E as Email
    C->>S: Submit order
    S->>O: Create checkout
    O->>I: Reserve stock
    I-->>O: Reserved
    O->>P: Authorize payment
    alt Payment approved
        P-->>O: Authorized
        O->>O: Create order
        O->>E: Send confirmation
        O-->>S: Order confirmed
        S-->>C: Confirmation
    else Payment failed
        P-->>O: Declined
        O-->>S: Payment failed
        S-->>C: Update payment
    end

diagrams.title: Signup and approval
diagrams.source:
sequenceDiagram
    participant U as User
    participant A as Admin Portal
    participant I as Identity
    participant C as CRM
    participant B as Billing
    U->>A: Submit signup
    A->>I: Verify identity
    I-->>A: Verified
    A->>C: Create account
    A->>B: Validate plan
    B-->>A: Plan ready
    A-->>U: Approval complete

diagrams.title: Provisioning and import
diagrams.source:
sequenceDiagram
    participant A as Admin Portal
    participant P as Provisioning
    participant B as Billing
    participant D as Data Import
    participant X as Audit

    P->>B: Activate subscription
    B-->>P: Active
    P->>D: Start import
    D-->>P: Import complete
    P->>X: Record provisioning
    P-->>A: Tenant ready

diagrams.title: Audit and handoff
diagrams.source:
sequenceDiagram
    participant P as Provisioning
    participant X as Audit
    participant S as Support
    participant E as Email
    participant U as User
    P->>X: Request completion check
    X-->>P: Audit passed
    P->>S: Create handoff

diagrams.title: Ownership
Query execution
Alerting and audit
Case lifecycle
diagrams.source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> New
    New --> Active
    Active --> WaitingForUser
    WaitingForUser --> Active
    Active --> Verifying
    Verifying --> Active : not done
    Verifying --> Closed : done
    New --> Cancelled
    Active --> Cancelled
    Closed --> [*]
    Cancelled --> [*]

diagrams.title: Active analysis loop
diagrams.source:
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Analysis
    Analysis --> Revision : findings
    Revision --> Analysis : re-evaluate
    Analysis --> Evaluation : ready
    Evaluation --> Revision : gaps
    Evaluation --> [*] : accepted

diagrams.title: User-supplied diagram
diagrams.source:
flowchart LR
    A[Request] --> B{Valid?}
    B -->|yes| C[Process]
    B -->|no| D[Revise]
    D --> A

diagrams.title: Incident resolution
diagrams.source:
flowchart TD
    S[Signal] --> T[Triage] --> A[Assign]
    A --> R[Resolve] --> V{Verify}
    V -->|pass| C[Close]
    V -->|retry| R

diagrams.title: 申請フロー
diagrams.source:
flowchart LR
    G[業務目的] --> I{入力情報は十分か}
    I -->|不足| Q[追加情報を依頼]
    Q --> I
    I -->|十分| R[専門担当が内容確認]
    R --> D{承認者が意思決定}
    D -->|差し戻し| R
    D -->|承認| S[外部システムへ登録]
    S --> V[結果確認] --> N[完了通知]

diagrams.title: 問い合わせ対応
diagrams.source:
flowchart TD
    A[問い合わせ受付] --> B[内容・緊急度を確認]
    B --> C[専門担当へ割り当て]
    C --> D[解決策を検討・実施]
    D --> E{顧客が結果確認}
    E -->|問題あり| D
    E -->|問題なし| F[対応完了]

diagrams.title: Delivery lifecycle
diagrams.source:
flowchart LR
    D[Discover] --> X{Decide}
    X -->|proceed| B[Build] --> V[Validate] --> L[Launch]
    X -->|reframe| D
    classDef peer font-size:16px
    classDef primary font-size:24px
    class D,B,V,L peer
    class X primary
